name: Enterprise Audit - Created, Deleted, Exported, Imported Content
description: Content - Created, Deleted, Exported, Imported DashBoard provides detailed information on content that is created, deleted, exported, and imported. The dashboard is organized according to activities performed by users in User Mode and Content Administrator Mode. You can view more granular data using pre-populated filters for Event Type, Content Type and Admin Mode.
title: Enterprise Audit - Created, Deleted, Exported, Imported Content

queries.queryString:
_index=sumologic_audit_events _sourceCategory=content and (ContentCreated OR ContentDeleted OR ContentExported OR ContentImported OR ContentImportCompleted OR ContentAsynchronousExportCompleted)
| json "eventName", "eventTime", "adminMode", "contentIdentity.name", "contentIdentity.type", "operator.email", "operator.id", "operator.sourceIp" as EventName, EventTime, AdminMode, ContentName, ContentType, UserEmail, UserId, UserIp nodrop
| where  EventName matches "{{EventName}}" and UserIp matches "{{UserIp}}" and AdminMode matches "{{AdminMode}}"
|count by EventName, EventTime, AdminMode, ContentName, ContentType, UserEmail, UserId, UserIp
| sort by EventTime
| fields - _count, UserId
| limit 10

_index=sumologic_audit_events _sourceCategory=content and (ContentCreated OR ContentDeleted OR ContentExported OR ContentImported OR ContentAsynchronousExportCompleted OR ContentImportCompleted OR ContentAsynchronousExportCompleted)
| json "eventName", "adminMode", "operator.sourceIp"as EventName, AdminMode, UserIp nodrop
| where EventName in ("ContentCreated", "ContentDeleted", "ContentExported", "ContentImported", "ContentImportCompleted", "ContentAsynchronousExportCompleted") AND AdminMode="false"
| where  EventName matches "{{EventName}}" and UserIp matches "{{UserIp}}" and AdminMode matches "{{AdminMode}}"
| timeslice 1d
| count as Count by _timeslice, EventName
| fillmissing timeslice(1d),
  values("ContentCreated", "ContentDeleted", "ContentExported", "ContentImported", "ContentImportCompleted", "ContentAsynchronousExportCompleted") in EventName
| transpose row _timeslice column EventName
